title: His brother and uncle
summary: His brother liked work and dancing, and his uncle led the Manetta Brass Band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: In SPR, at Polylumber. Southern Pacific, okay?

And my uncle had a brass band. He called Mineta Brass Band. Well, it'd take him to play a bass drum. He liked the bass drum. He liked to play cornet just for pleasure. He'd go around women's house with his cornet and play for pleasure. But you couldn't hide. Well, all right. He carried me all around. Did he dance over the funky butt?

Or just took the ball? No, he didn't dance. No, he didn't dance. It was too wild for him in there, you know. Of course, he was a fellow going around wild people, but he didn't have more respect for that.
